part_c.text_en: An AI assistant confidently tells you the name of your state's Chief Minister. What should you do before using this answer?

options.label_en: Use it, AI is always right
Check it with an official source

part_c.text_en: Which request will get the most useful answer?

options.label_en: "Write a short, polite leave letter to my principal for 2 days of sick leave, in simple English"

Which task should you NOT hand to an AI tool to decide?

options.label_en: A first draft of a notice
The medicine dose for a patient

options.label_en: Reply to the voice note to confirm
Call your manager on their known number before doing anything

options.label_en: The customer's name, phone number and account number

options.label_en: Add a step to your method: check key numbers against the source every time

part_c.text_en: You want to know if your weekly AI method is reliable. Which is the best test?

options.label_en: Run it once on this week's report
Run it on three past reports, including one unusual one, and check each output
Ask the AI if it is reliable
Use it for a month and see

options.label_en: Check the time on the official railway app or at the station
Ask the AI the same question again
Assume it is a little wrong and leave early

Look for the same news on trusted news sites or official accounts

Switch to a different AI tool at random
